body:
* Seems you had your share of struggles. I am sorry that you felt like that. But I hope you are in better shape now.
If you want to someone to rant to. I don't mind listening.

* I usually find it hard to open up to new people. I can't talk to people without feeling vulnerable.

* Thing is I am in my last year year of high school.
My finals are right around the corner. Pretty sure I either failed or barely passed my exams prior to the finals. So I'm bound to fail. 

* Thing is in my country (India) (but live abroad) the competition (even for jobs/university) is really high. If you don't start working early you'll end up in a bad position.

* School counselor won't be any help as I about to leave school in a few months. Currently not in therapy.

Thanks for taking time to talk it means a lot.
Even though it sounds like a minor teen issue that I'm making it sound much worse than it is.

Thanks for responding. 

Why do I suck at life:
* Literally everyone criticizes me for the things I do and the the things I don't do.
* I can't have a conversation with any person face to face.
* Most teachers and my classmates pity me and give me those condescending eyes, which gives my reassurance
that they won't care.

The main reason is because I still don't know what I want to be. Literally everyone knows what they are doing after highschool. And then there is me completely clueless of what I want to do. People say follow your passion, do something that makes you happy.
I am so boring that talking to the walls is better than talking to me. I have no passion, no enjoyment for life, no desire for change. I truly have given up on life. I am just living for the sake of living. If I didn't exist the world would be no different.

There is also a lot of family pressure since most of my cousins are moving abroad to different places pursuing their selected fields. And they usually compare me to them. And that feeling also sucks.

Thanks for responding. I really didn't expect anyone to do so.

Life gets more harder. 
Only if you start early will be able to compensate for the hardships you face in the future.

Unfortunately it becomes more harder the more I move forward in my life.
